title: SM Sports and Leisure invests P1-billion to multi-sports facilities nationwide
summary: SM Supermalls is about to have one of the largest mall-based facilities for sports and active lifestyle with more developments underway

blocks.text: SM Supermalls is about to have one of the largest mall-based facilities for sports and active lifestyle with more developments underway

Editor’s note: This press release is sponsored by SM Supermalls and was handled by BrandRap, the sales and marketing arm of Rappler. No member of the news and editorial team participated in the publishing of this piece.

SM Supermalls is reinforcing its commitment to making active lifestyles more accessible to Filipinos by investing P1 billion to build multi-sport facilities and active social hubs all over the country. These establishments will serve as additional spaces where communities can play, compete, connect, and embrace more active lifestyles.

“More and more Filipinos are shifting to an active lifestyle. The SM Supermalls will be at the forefront and will lead this movement. We will make fitness and wellness be accessible and inclusive to all, whether you are just starting out or an advanced athlete. We will build the largest community in our malls where everyone can make active living part of everyday life, said Steven T. Tan, SM Supermalls president.

SM Supermalls’ new active hubs will feature tournament-grade sports facilities that meet international standards. These are designed to accommodate both recreational play and high-level tournaments. Enthusiasts and experienced players can enjoy a variety of sports programs and share their passion for play, health, and wellness.

blocks.caption: GETTING PHYSICAL. More Filipinos can embrace active lifestyles as SM builds more sports facilities

blocks.text: The new facilities, spread across the country, will bring Filipinos closer to quality sports infrastructure, where they can create new memories with a thriving, active community.

The P1 billion investment is the mall operator’s latest sports and recreation initiative. Since the 1990s, SM Supermalls has built venues and hosted events to encourage active lifestyles. It has organized workshops and tournaments for all ages and skill levels, in its quest to make fitness inclusive for all.

This latest project fortifies SM Supermalls’ position as the country’s largest mall-based sports and active lifestyle network. It currently has 108 pickleball courts, 176 bowling lanes nationwide, and three Olympic-sized ice skating rinks, where professional athletes perfect their craft and where enthusiasts pursue their sports hobbies.

blocks.caption: TRAINING GROUNDS. SM Supermalls’ ice-skating rinks and bowling alleys are home to both hobbyists and future champions

blocks.text: “Active and wellness is not new to SM Supermalls. For over 30 years, we have continuously organized events and created spaces for Filipinos to stay connected through sports. We will continue this pledge by expanding our footprint to more communities,” Tan said.

Every year, thousands of athletes, families, and barkadas head to SM Supermalls’ active facilities where they hone their skills and passions. These communities create meaningful active experiences in welcoming, inclusive spaces. Through regular training and mall-led events, they build skills, forge new connections, and become part of a community that stays active together.

blocks.caption: FOR EVERYONE. Hobbyists, experienced athletes, and newbies are welcome to play at SM Supermalls’ active hubs
COMFORT SPACE. SM Supermalls continues to lead active living through open plays, clinics, tournaments or simply playing with peers at your fave space

blocks.text: As it moves forward, SM Supermalls will continue to partner with the Filipino active community in championing active lifestyles. Through this investment, it will empower more communities to engage in new experiences and reach their wellness goals. – Rappler.com
